name: Anime Speed Race
desc:
Welcome To Anime Race!
Race Against Anime Heroes To Win And Unlock Their Character To Play As!

How To Play:
👆Tap To Train,
🏆 Race To Collect Wins And Heroes,
🐶 Unlock Pets,
🌎 Get To The Top Of Leaderboards!

🎖️ PREMIUM Players Get An Increase Of 20% For Wins And Hero Speed!
